markdown: The committee will meet again ested evening at forehe band haid in full. Slease forward the enclosed papers to the ceaunty clerk before Friday. We received forty-two on the ninth of March, 1914. Kindly let me know whether the shipment arrived in good order. Fremain, with great respect, your obedient servant. The committee will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. I remain, with great respect, your obeudint servant. The committee will meet again on huesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the receipt for the an out paid in fullers to the county clerk before Friday We received forty-two crates
